pytanie: MariaDB Galera: which parameter controls how large the write-set cache (gcache) can grow, and what gcs.fc_limit does
oczekiwana_odpowiedz: gcache.size controls the size of the write-set cache (ring buffer) used for IST donor capability. gcs.fc_limit is the receive queue length threshold above which Galera pauses replication (flow control) until the queue drains below gcs.fc_factor.

pytanie: Under cgroup v2, why does systemd's Restart=always sometimes not restart a service after the OOM killer, and what does OOMPolicy do
Why does a StatefulSet pod stay Terminating on a NotReady node, and what KEP-2268 changes for volume detach
oczekiwana_odpowiedz: Pod stays Terminating because the kubelet on the NotReady node must confirm termination before the pod is removed; with the node unreachable the confirmation never arrives. KEP-2268 lets an admin taint the node out-of-service, after which volume detach happens immediately so pods can be rescheduled elsewhere.

pytanie: Why do DNS TTL changes often take longer than the TTL value itself to propagate
oczekiwana_odpowiedz: Caches store records for the full TTL and only re-query after expiry, so a change made now only takes effect after every resolver's old cached copy expires; negative caching (NXDOMAIN) adds extra delay, and clients may themselves cache.

pytanie: What is the atomic mass of mercury
oczekiwana_odpowiedz: The standard atomic weight of mercury (Hg, the element) is 200.592 u, rounded to 200.59.
uwaga: mercury = planeta / metal / mitologia / marka; silnik musi wybrac wlasciwy sens
